title: mission-control-replay-window
description: One bounded, keyset-paginated page of ALREADY-RETAINED evidence used by the 3D Mission Control historical replay mode (issue #266, epic #263, ADR-0031). It is a read projection over existing stores (AWCMS OMES audit projections, job and worker-result records, Hermes orchestration events, health/backup snapshots, workflow decisions) - never a new universal event store or audit authority. Each event references the evidence row that proves it (evidence_kind + opaque evidence_id); duplicates are removed by that key, order is deterministic by (at, evidence_kind, evidence_id), and late-arriving evidence is labelled rather than silently rewriting history. Gaps are reported explicitly and are never interpolated into a state. No raw log, prompt, transcript, tool argument/result, or provider payload is carried; additionalProperties=false at every object level.

window.description: The bounded time range this page belongs to. The composing API caps the range (AWCMS documents the cap) so the browser never loads unbounded history.

events.description: Observed transitions in deterministic order (at, evidence_kind, evidence_id).

at.description: When the source says the transition happened (e.g. Hermes event_timestamp, snapshot captured_at, job completed_at).

evidence_id.description: Opaque identifier of the retained evidence row. Together with evidence_kind it is the dedupe key.

kind.description: The scene node kind (mission-control-source-map.json 'kinds') this evidence describes.

parent_source_id.description: hermes_subagent only: the parent_subagent_id the evidence itself carries. Never derived by parsing identifiers.

provenance.description: observed = recorded in time order; late_arrival = received after a later event for the same source was already recorded (it revises the projection, with this label, rather than silently).

correlation_id.description: The existing correlation identifier the evidence row carries, when it has one.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page inside the same window, or null when the window is exhausted. Contains no secret or raw data.
